method: Fit the MAST calibrated pixel response of a source at the fixed JWST position and eight spatial controls jointly, using QUALITY=0 and finite flux/errors at all pixels. Subtract a median reference excluding the UTC day under measurement. Use a local quadratic radial background, reference scene, and its two gradients as nuisance terms. Bin in fixed UTC hours and days, retaining windows with at least 60% cadence completeness. Subtract TIMECORR from BTJD to reconstruct cadence midpoint UTC. Use the larger of formal errors and formal errors scaled by the MAD of flux/formal error. A second fit uses one nuisance offset per detector column and quadratic row terms to test the effect of stripes in the residual images. Both fits list excursions that exceed score five while all eight same-window control scores have magnitude below five.
recovery_scope: Analytic matched-profile recovery on measured control residuals. Controls are rescaled to target uncertainty within corresponding windows. We quote the increment needed to exceed residual score 5 in at least 90% of such trials, conditional on observed windows and a fixed difference-image reference. Controls share images and are not independent global false-alarm trials. Magnitudes approximate the incremental TESS-band source flux using the instrument zeropoint, on the TESS Vega-based scale. Bright sources can saturate. Brief flares and signals in gaps or spanning much of a sector may be missed.
